caption:
Under 500 calorie chicken noodle stir fry

Ingredients
- 200 grams chicken marinated with 1/2 tsp gochujang paste 
- 1 tsp oil
- 5 cloves garlic, finely chopped
- 2 green chilli, finely chopped
- 1 spring onion, both bulb and stems chopped
- Handful of spinach, chopped
- 100 grams mushroom 
- 1 tsp gochujang paste
- 50 grams atta noodles, I use @masterchow.in
